description: This file defines a TimeZone class that manages timezone settings and calculations for date/time conversions, including validation, setting/retrieving the default timezone, and computing timezone adjustments with consideration for daylight saving time.

classes.name: TimeZone
classes.description: A utility class to manage timezone information including validation, setting, and calculating timezone offsets for date/time conversions.

methods.name: validateTimeZone
methods.description: Checks if a given timezone name is valid according to PHP's list of timezone identifiers.

methods.name: setTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the default timezone used for date/time conversions if the provided timezone name is valid.

methods.name: getTimeZone
methods.description: Returns the currently set default timezone.

methods.name: getTimeZoneAdjustment
methods.description: Calculates the timezone offset in seconds for a given timezone name and timestamp, accounting for daylight saving time if applicable.
